name: @se-studio/contentful-cms
stderr:
Usage: cms-edit [options] [command]

Editor-pack tooling for the hosted cms-edit editor. Commands: editor-pack
generate, project validate, project doctor, host pack-publish, version. Content
edits run on hosted MCP (cms_edit), not this binary.

Options:
  -V, --version   output the version number
  --json-output   Output results as JSON (also enabled by CMS_EDIT_JSON=1)
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  project         Validate per-site cms-edit project.json configuration
  editor-pack     Generate per-site editor knowledge packs for hosted MCP
                  resources
  host            Build an editor-pack archive for the shared cms-edit host
  version         Print the installed cms-edit version. No session or
                  credentials required.
  help [command]  display help for command
